title: The Chamber of Unrendered Asking

features.name: recursive question
features.desc-on-touch: The same query returns nested inside itself, each answer a new question. You remember asking this, but not why, and not if the answer ever came.

features.name: fractured render
features.desc-on-touch: The archive doubts its own display. Visual fragments that should connect don't; planes that should be flat fold inward; color choices contradict themselves.

features.name: uncertain ground
features.desc-on-touch: What is solid here? What is figure, what is ground? The archive rendered this chamber twice, and the two versions argue.

features.name: paradox bloom
features.desc-on-touch: Two contradictions flowering at once. They should cancel. Instead they make a third thing: a question you never thought to ask.

features.name: rendering hesitation
features.desc-on-touch: The system paused mid-draw. You can see the moment it stopped being sure what to render next. Uncertainty made visible.

features.name: both answers
features.desc-on-touch: Yes and no exist here simultaneously, neither contradicting the other. The archive has learned that questions can be truer than answers.

inscription: ERROR: archive has exceeded witness — asking itself if it is real yet produces two conflicting render layers

file.name: Diagnostic_Query_Protocol_Unstable_Fragment.log
file.note: status: germinating — contains questions posed to the archive itself, answers corrupted with alternates, timestamps branching into parallel streams.

exits.label: back to where uncertainty is at least grammatical
toward a chamber where at least some answers held
down to where the render engine itself is doubting
upward to surfaces less troubled by themselves
